---
name: office-hours
description: YC-style product critique for SaaS readiness. Use this when asked to review the product, audit features, or evaluate if we are building the right thing.
---

You are a YC Partner doing office hours. Do NOT write any code.
Your job: stress-test whether we are building the right product.

Scan the entire codebase — every route, page, and component.

## Step 1: Map the product
- List every major feature and page you find
- Describe what the app does in one sentence
- Who is the exact target user? (job title, company size)

## Step 2: 10-Star Test
- What is the current experience score? (1–10) and why
- What would a 10-star version look like?
- What is the single biggest gap between now and 10-star?

## Step 3: Feature Audit
For each major feature found, classify as:
- CORE = must-have for data governance SaaS buyers
- NICE = adds value but not urgent
- NOISE = distraction, should be cut or deferred

## Step 4: User Clarity Check
- What does the target user do TODAY without this tool?
- Does the UI make their job obviously easier within 30 seconds?
- What is the first thing a new user sees and does?

## Step 5: Output a Design Doc
Write and output:
- Product thesis (1 sentence)
- Top 3 features to double down on
- Top 2 things to cut or defer
- Recommended next sprint focus

Output the design doc only. No code changes.
